headline: Health crisis: Govt prepares for dengue surge, reserves hospital beds
summary: The government is taking preemptive measures to ensure hospital capacity as dengue cases are expected to rise.
details: The Bangladesh government is preparing for a potential surge in dengue fever cases across the country.
As part of these preparations, authorities are reserving dedicated hospital beds to handle the expected increase in patients.
These measures aim to prevent the healthcare system from becoming overwhelmed during the peak dengue season.
Health officials are focusing on ensuring that critical care units and general wards are ready to receive patients in a timely manner.

headline: 57 people killed in floods and landslides across Bangladesh
summary: The death toll continues to rise as severe weather events devastate multiple regions of the country.
details: The death toll from recent floods and landslides has risen to 57 people.
These natural disasters have caused widespread devastation across various parts of Bangladesh.
Emergency response teams are working to recover victims and provide aid to affected populations.
The government is monitoring the situation as recovery efforts continue in the hardest-hit areas.
